summary: Class 7 ICSE Biology Topic 07: Human Excretory System & Kidney in the warm editorial aesthetic (#fbfaf7 ivory canvas, Newsreader serif, rich black #161514). Features primary nitrogenous excretory organs (Kidneys, Ureters, Urinary Bladder, Urethra), microscopic nephron anatomy (Bowman's Capsule, Glomerulus, Loop of Henle), and the 3 stages of urine formation (Ultrafiltration, Selective Reabsorption, Tubular Secretion). Zero SVGs.
